subject: Asteria MAP & Handoff — Implementation stages, owners, and fallback plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>; Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Handoff: Asteria MAP + initial milestone pack (see attachments)

Irene / Monica — attaching the working Mutual Action Plan for Asteria Health so we can transition ownership. Key asks: review milestone owners, confirm go‑live windows, and flag any technical or procurement blockers.

High level:
- Business goal: pilot Redwood Hosted inference for triage-assist across 4 hospitals by Q3 calendar.
- Primary success metric: average latency < 350ms P95 for 512 token inference; onboarding NPS >= 9 after 6 weeks.
- Initial scope: 3 models (diagnostic-assist small, reranker, embeddings for search).

Attachments: MAP-Asteria-v0.9.xlsx (working MAP), SOW-draft-Asteria.pdf (procurement draft).

Immediate open items (from discovery):
1) Network access: Asteria wants private endpoints in their VPC — need network diagram and security checklist.
2) Data retention: default 30 days, procurement asking for 90-day logs retention option.
3) Migrations: plan for model variant fallback if GPU capacity constrained.

Suggested owners in MAP (editable):
- CS lead / kick: Irene Choi
- Technical lead / integration: Karthik Iyer
- Procurement / SOW PM: Monica Patel

Next steps: Irene, can you review and propose a week-by-week milestone cadence (6–8 week runway) and identify any additional dependencies? I’ll join the first handoff call with Asteria on Wednesday to introduce you.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(attachment: MAP-Asteria-v0.9.xlsx)
(attachment: SOW-draft-Asteria.pdf)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: Asteria MAP + initial milestone pack (see attachments)

Thanks Marissa — review complete. I sketched a pragmatic 7-week implementation plan in-line below and updated owners where it made sense. High level approach: parallelize infra/network + model onboarding work in weeks 1–3, then validation and acceptance in weeks 4–7.

Proposed condensed timeline (week numbers relative to kickoff):
Week 0 (kickoff): Introductions, scope confirmation, sign SOW (owner: Monica)
Weeks 1–2: Network & security (VPC peering, firewall rules, cert exchanges) (owner: Karthik)
Weeks 1–3: Model packaging & quantization tests (owner: Karthik + Research ops)
Week 3: Staging deploy + end-to-end smoke tests (owner: Irene)
Weeks 4–5: User acceptance + prompt tuning sessions with Asteria SMEs (owner: Irene + Asteria SMEs)
Week 6: Performance tuning, cost profile review, rollback/fallback policy finalization (owner: Irene / Platform eng)
Week 7: Go‑live + 30/60/90 day adoption checkpoints (owner: Monica for commercial handover)

Risks & fallback notes:
- Procurement delay: propose a 2-week buffer before ordering dedicated capacity; fallback to hosted multi-tenant for initial pilot.
- Network approvals: If Asteria cannot approve VPC peering in time, we will use a Transit Gateway approach with strict IP allow lists and encryption.
- Model perf regression: Use canary rollout with automatic fallback to a smaller quantized model; include an explicit rollback window in the MAP.

Open questions for Asteria (to confirm on the kickoff):
1) Single sign-on: will Asteria request SCIM provisioned accounts for Redwood Console?
2) Data residency: any regional constraints outside of standard US hosting?
3) Logging retention: confirm whether 90-day retention is a firm requirement.

I updated the MAP spreadsheet with the timeline and marked owners. Monica, can you take the procurement path and share the updated SOW with their procurement contact? I’ll draft the kickoff agenda and sample test plan before our call.

Irene Choi
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Jamie Collins <jamie.collins@asteriahealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement Team <contracts@asteriahealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: Asteria MAP + initial milestone pack (see attachments)

Irene / team — thanks for the update and the clear timeline. We’re aligned with the 7-week runway in principle. A few quick notes before the kickoff:

1) Procurement: contracts@asteriahealth.com is now on the thread — we’ll review the SOW and come back with redlines. We have a standard security addendum that requests a 90-day logging retention option; that’s likely non-negotiable for our compliance team.
2) Network: we prefer Transit Gateway for now (our security team is conservative about peering). Karthik, what additional info do you need from our network team?
3) SMEs: I’ll loop Dr. Priya Narang (clinical lead) into the UAT sessions; she’s available starting May 17.

Availability: We propose kickoff on Wednesday 2027-05-12 at 10:00 AM PT if that works for your team. Please send the calendar invite and a short agenda.

—Jamie
Jamie Collins
Director, Clinical Innovation | Asteria Health
(jamie.collins@asteriahealth.com)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamie Collins <jamie.collins@asteriahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement Team <contracts@asteriahealth.com>
Bcc: 
Date: 2027-05-04T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: Asteria MAP + initial milestone pack (see attachments)

Thanks Jamie — that timing works. I’ll send the kickoff invite and attach an agenda and the updated MAP spreadsheet (final v0.9 with owners and the fallback policy section). Quick answers inline:

- Logging retention: noted as 90 days. Monica — please include a 90-day option in the SOW and flag any delta in pricing.
- Network info: Karthik will follow up with a short network checklist (CIDR ranges, allowed ports, PKI/cert details) — can Asteria share a point-of-contact for the network team?
- SCIM/SSO: If Asteria wants SCIM, that’s an add-on. We’ll call it out in the SOW options.

Action list (post-kickoff):
- Monica: finalize SOW with 90-day logging option and send DocuSign link to Procurement (owner: Monica)
- Karthik: share Transit Gateway checklist and ask for network POC (owner: Karthik)
- Irene: send kickoff invite + agenda + test plan (owner: Irene)

See you Wednesday,
Irene
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
